revealed_content.statement: The bundled current returns policy v2 explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claim is supported.
revealed_content.plan: Extract numeric return windows from policy_docs, base_retrieval, and base_judge_reference_days; compare the current v2 value to the claimed 30 days and to the stale 14-day references; no two-group means were provided, so a t-test is not applicable and a deterministic consistency check was used.

evidence.test: deterministic numeric consistency check; two-sample t-test not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields are present
